metadata_findings.synchronization: camera exposure pulses and lidar UTC/PPS are documented
metadata_findings.labels: public 3D object labels exist at approximately 5 Hz; not opened in this audit
metadata_findings.known_risk: public pyboreas issue 41 reports inconsistent tracking UUIDs in some consecutive frames

exclusions: Do not count the 37 scene intervals as independent sessions.
Do not project 3D labels into RGB as model inputs or supplied-box inputs.
Do not derive or inspect TTC before model, population and truth derivation are frozen.
Do not call this an official Boreas TTC benchmark.
reservation_blockers: Only one physical acquisition session is identified by the official object split.
No official TTC label or TTC evaluation protocol exists.
An independent, target-blind TTC construction and UUID repair policy remain unspecified.
